answer: The prism schedule is applied in meadow and voyage shows each instalment. A payout is split which means 45% arrives at settlement and the rest over 13 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An attacker therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4169 identities would post 2077 proofs and burn roughly 10 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
